page.layout: Running head top left, page number top right. Then a bare numeral "XXIV.", a title in small capitals with a summary line below, and an italic caption line. Then the work title "PORTÆ TRIVMPHALES ALIÆ.", and one running-text block in full width, with a large initial P. Bottom: signature "P" at left, catchword "nomi-" at right.

main_text.l: surdum putavimus hoc loco brevissimè at-
texere duas alias Portas triumphales, Nu-
rembergæ olim erectas: Earum verò typus seu
prolixa, ob causas partim supra dictas, partim
alia impedimenta, operi pro tempore inferi
non potuit. Interim benevolus lector quali
quali hac descriptiuncula desiderium, si quod
habet, expleat. Atq; alteram quidem iusta
cis ornatam, invictiss. Imp. Cæs. Carolo, ejus
cum xv i. Februarii Anno M. D. XLI. primum
natu, invictiss. Imp. Cæs. Maximiliano, ejus

page.notes: Sources for the transcription: the page is clean, with no marginal notes. The "P" at the foot is a gathering signature and "nomi-" is a catchword; both are kept out of the text. The "xv i." and "Anno M. D. XLI." are copied as printed. The line ending "ejus" is the last full line and is not followed by further printed text on this page.
